openers.direct_offer_default: Hi {agent_name}, my name is Lana. I'm interested in your listing on {street}. I reviewed the numbers — I'll be at ${offer} cash with a {close_days}-day close. If this is something your client is interested in, let me know and I can get a contract sent over.
openers.direct_offer_short: Hi {agent_name}, Lana here. Interested in {street}. I reviewed the numbers and can be at ${offer} cash with a {close_days}-day close. Let me know if that works for your seller and I can get a contract sent over.

offers.sms_loi_summary: LOI Terms for {address}: Purchase Price: ${offer} Cash. Earnest Money: $2,500. Feasibility Period: 14 days. Closing Date: {close_days} days. Listing commission protected. Proof of funds verified. Let me know if this works to open escrow. Lana, Acquisitions Coordinator.

objections.OBJECTION_PRICE_FIRM: I respect where your seller wants to be. My client is an active infill builder, so our numbers are tied directly to current build costs and back end resale comps. We are ready to move quickly with zero financing contingencies at ${offer} cash. This offer is valid for 5 business days.
objections.OBJECTION_COUNTER_OFFER: I reviewed this with my client. We have a little room to bridge the gap and can come up to ${counter_offer} cash with the same {close_days}-day close. Would that get this across the finish line for your seller?
objections.OBJECTION_OTHER_INTEREST: Understood, that makes complete sense. A lot of retail buyers struggle to secure construction loans right now. If your current buyer stalls on financing or feasibility, we are ready to step in at ${offer} cash with a {close_days}-day close. This offer is valid for 5 business days.
objections.OBJECTION_WHY_SO_LOW: Running the numbers through our infill builder calculator: finished new construction in this pocket sells around ${finished_value}. At current structure costs of ${build_cost_psf} per sqft for a {planned_sqft} sqft build (${total_build_cost}), plus our client's standard {builder_profit_pct} percent builder margin and holding fees, that puts our maximum land basis right at ${max_payable} cash. We opened at ${offer}. Would it make sense to send over our contract or full LOI?
objections.OBJECTION_CLIENT_REAL: Yes, absolutely. My client is a local residential builder actively pouring foundations and completing spec single family homes in the area. We have verified cash proof of funds and close on vacant lots with zero lender red tape. Happy to send our written contract or LOI to you by text or email.
objections.OBJECTION_SEND_LOI: Awesome, would you prefer the formal written LOI sent over via text here, or directly to your email?
objections.OBJECTION_IDENTITY: Hi {agent_name}, this is Lana with Peak Investments. We partner with local residential home builders acquiring buildable infill lots for spec new construction.

followups.friday_sequence: Hi {agent_name}, is {street} still available? Would your client reconsider my offer of ${offer}?
followups.end_of_month_blitz: Hi {agent_name}, circling back on {street}. Would your client reconsider my cash offer of ${offer} to get this wrapped up this month?
followups.agent_consolidation: Hi {agent_name}, my name is Lana. I'm interested in your listings on {streets}. I reviewed the numbers — I'll be at ${total_offer} cash with a {close_days}-day close for the package. If this is something your clients are open to, let me know and I can get contracts sent over.
